name: Sauron

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Prowess kaldıran şampiyon neredeyse zorunlu; yoksa dövüşün büyük kısmında aktif olan engellenemez saldırıya dikkat et. Onu E2 kullanmaya zorla. Engellenemez özel saldırıları bloklayabilen şampiyonlar da iyi.
signatureAbility:
Doctor's Gift
After the start of the fight, if the Opponent attempts to inflict a Bleed, or Incinerate effect while a Degeneration Passive is active, inflict the Opponent with a Passive version of that effect dealing +[35,784] damage over 2 seconds.
Increase personal Prowess Passive Potency by a flat [2 - 10]%.
immunityDetails:
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• %95 Kanama direnci 🩸
• Güç Çalma Bağışıklığı 🔋🔽
• İyileşme Tersine Çevirmeye dirençli 💚🔄❌

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Immune to all Power Steal, Poison, and Sauron's Regeneration Rate cannot be decreased or increased by outside sources.
Take -95% less damage from Bleed effects and gain +25% Critical Resistance while Bleeding.
When Sauron is struck, 30% chance to gain a Regen Passive healing 10% of the damage taken per personal Prowess Passive effect he has.
Light Attacks have 35% chance to deal 50% of the damage dealt as a burst of Physical Damage. This ability can also trigger through block.

abilitySections.title: Prowess (Max: 10)
content: Each time one of Sauron's Abilities fails to trigger due to chance gain a 10% Prowess Passive. Gain an additional 2 Prowess Passive if Sauron's Ability fails due to Ability Accuracy modification.

At 7 Prowess Passives, Dash Attacks, Heavy and Special Attacks grant an Unblockable Passive for 4 seconds. This Unblockable Passive is paused during Special Attacks and has a 10 second cooldown unless Sauron's Ability Accuracy is being modified or Sauron is affected by a Degeneration.
At 10 Prowess Passives, Dashing Attacks, inflict a Bleed Passive, dealing +[8,946] damage over 4 seconds. This ability can also trigger through block.
Landing the first hit of a Heavy Attack will consume 3 Prowess Passives and gain a Fury Passive, granting +[5,964] Attack Rating for 4 seconds

abilitySections.title: All Special Attacks
content: All Prowess Passives are removed at the end of Special Attacks.
On activation, pause the Degeneration Passive from Extinction Mode for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Extinction Mode
content: While at 10 Prowess Passives, when you hit the Opponent, inflict a Degeneration Passive, dealing +[4,771.2] direct damage over 5 seconds.
Increase Physical Burst Potency by 50% and all personal Abilities have 100% Ability Accuracy.
If the Degeneration Passive from Extinction Mode expires, remove all Prowess Passives.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: After this Special Attack ends, for each physical burst hit dealt to the Opponent, heal for 25% the damage dealt for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: After this Special Attack ends, increase the Potency of all personal burst Physical Damage by 100% for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: After this Special Attack ends, inflict a Degeneration Passive, dealing +[2,982] direct damage over 5 seconds per personal Passive effect that has expired on Sauron or on the Opponent. (capped at 30) Reset after Special 3 activation.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Doctor's Gift
content: After the start of the fight, if the Opponent attempts to inflict a Bleed, or Incinerate effect while a Degeneration Passive is active, inflict the Opponent with a Passive version of that effect dealing +[35,784] damage over 2 seconds.
Increase personal Prowess Passive Potency by a flat [2 - 10]%.
